_comment: Single source of truth for CinemaWin's doctrine constants. Loaded by backend/config.py (Python) and imported by src/lib/doctrine.js (browser). Every number here traces to a section of the five spec documents in backend/prompts/doctrine/. Change a number here and both the server and the browser follow.
_score_categories_source: Module 04 §II — 100-Point Greenlight Scorecard. Order and maximums are fixed; they sum to 100.
_verdict_thresholds_source: Module 04 §II Decision Thresholds. [min_inclusive, verdict, label], checked top-down.
_capital_layers_source: Module 03 §II — The 4-Layer Capital Stack. Layers must sum to 100%; Equity Gap absorbs the remainder.
_budget_tiers_source: Module 03 §I — Data-Driven Budget Ceilings. [upper_exclusive_bound, tier]; null is the catch-all.
